obfuscation_indicators: likely result in significantly lower demand
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and well quantified, including segment trends, COVID-19 testing revenue, margin changes, recall impacts, and geographic exposure. Key risks include declining pandemic-related demand, the infant formula recall and facility disruption, inflation, supply-chain constraints, foreign exchange, and uncertain regulatory developments. Management uses moderate forward-looking language but also describes mitigation actions and resilient underlying business trends.
